description: Saves a tiered visit review about one staffer as a staff_events row (kind coaching_review), as New review on their Coaching tab does: staffId, content (visit details, wentWell[], tier1[] priority feedback, tier2[] items each with text and optional photos[], and closing), and optional occurredOn, clientId, bookingId. The review body and thumbnails are derived from content. It is NOT sent to the staffer here (delivery is a separate gated step). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: save_coaching_review
title: Save a coaching review
